steps.imagePrompt: Flat vector illustration, 16:9 ratio, for an online C++ course. On an elevated reinforced telemetry pylon at Mars base IRIS overlooking the vast crimson-grey Mawrth Vallis basin at twilight. An ominous, dense atmospheric dust storm front rolls across the distant horizon under an amber-tinted Martian sky. On the landing pads below, Scout drone Sigma (agile, dark carbon-slate faceted armor, glowing amber thrusters) and Surveyor drone Delta (heavy-lift twin rotor shrouds, prominent LiDAR aperture) stand anchored. Standing inside the observation post at a tactical safety console displaying radar vector grids is the course mascot: strictly two freestanding cream-colored square brackets facing each other [ ] with two round cream circular eyes between them. The mascot has NO legs, NO feet, NO body, NO black bounding box, NO arms. Minimalist geometric flat vector, solid color fills, zero outlines, no gradients, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, technical, calm, and precise. Color palette strictly: background #090B0F, structural surfaces #151A22, warm grey #B7B0A4, cream #D8D0C2, and single accents of aged brass #B99A61 on the telemetry screens and muted sage #7FB3A3 on radar vectors.
